requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The printer must support NGB keyed bottles with 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, with the ability for CMY bottles to exceed 8,000-page yield.
requirements.Rationale: To increase consumable efficiency and reduce user intervention, supporting higher page yields is essential for business and SMB segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new bottle design and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accepts NGB keyed bottles and achieves specified page yields (6K Black, 6K+ CMY) in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The system must ensure spill-free reliability when replacing or refilling ink bottles.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces mess and increases user satisfaction and safety, especially in office and SMB environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with NOA-F and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage observed in 100 consecutive replacement/refill cycles under standard usage conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: The NOA-F (Non-Original Authentication-Filter) must use a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, while maintaining the existing click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security and compatibility while leveraging existing mechanisms to minimize redesign.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on current push-push and TDF system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is manufactured with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, passes all functional and security validation.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: The design must reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink without requiring ink reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven technology to reduce R&D cost and accelerate time to market.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink used without reformulation; printer meets performance and reliability targets.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling and Characterization
requirements.Description: Conduct comprehensive modeling and characterization of ink stability, including WVTR, air gain, flow rate, IDS, and startup/NOA-F EOL impacts.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product reliability and print quality throughout the product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires test data from new tank and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability models completed and validated; print quality remains within spec throughout projected product life.

requirements.Title: Support for Service Parts and Warranty
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for warranty support; support for new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Improves post-sales service and aligns with extended warranty offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Availability of NOA-F service parts, system design for 80K page life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F service parts available; system passes 80K page life validation under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: The product lid must integrate Acumen 6 technology.
requirements.Rationale: Likely required for authentication, tracking, or enhanced functionality (based on HP jargon).
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with lid manufacturing process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 successfully integrated and validated on production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration Updates for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and ensure assembly of PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures efficient manufacturing and assembly for new product features.
requirements.Dependencies: Availability of new molds, tools, and line modifications.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines updated and validated for new components; meets production throughput targets.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization and Tank Protrusion Alignment
requirements.Description: Optimize product size, including input and output tray changes to accommodate tank protrusion and increase tank size (Reddington ID).
requirements.Rationale: Maintains product ergonomics and aesthetics while supporting larger ink tanks.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updates to mechanical design and trays.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes ergonomic and fit tests; trays align with tank protrusion; tank size increased as specified.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and usability for advanced features and settings.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires update to control panel and electronics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display functional and passes usability tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage 4 Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink throughput and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical design changes for routing and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink delivery system with 4 tubes passes reliability and throughput tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station to manage aerosols, incorporating changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains reliability with new ink tank configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service station redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels within safety and reliability limits during operation and maintenance.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new component weights.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized tube routing and weights.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage passes dynamic and force validation tests with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Update for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update the paper path to support the increased page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and reliability over extended product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires paper path durability enhancements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path supports 80,000 pages without increased jam or failure rates.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80K Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: Supports long-term reliability and serviceability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design for maintenance part.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced at service centers post-80K page life; validated in service procedure tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement a new IDS (Ink Delivery System) make-break and FI (Fluidic Interconnect) connection, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability, supports new ink tank sizes, and improves system integration.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new IDS and ink-tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS and FI connection validated for reliability and compatibility with new tank sizes and keying.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop and implement a new IDS startup algorithm with improved air management.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable system startup and print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires IDS and firmware update.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup and air management algorithm pass system validation and field tests.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Measurement
requirements.Description: Define new Print Quality (PQ) goals and depletion measurement to meet page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns product performance with marketing and warranty claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires print quality testing and new measurement protocol.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion measurements validated and meet page yield specifications.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi, Dune FW
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi module, and Dune firmware in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development risk and leverages proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Component compatibility with new system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components function correctly in the Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Security with Gauss4.xx
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx for hardware and firmware security.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product security and compliance with HP standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with hardware and firmware components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features implemented and pass HP security validation.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental standards for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and market requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and material selection for compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for product packaging.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all drop and vibration tests with EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the system to allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user serviceability and reduces downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design for replaceable components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F without special tools; validated in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Business Models and Solutions
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths. Solutions to include scan, SMB manageability, enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM), and various clients/drivers (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD).
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports diverse customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software/firmware support and integration with HP solutions ecosystem.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All specified business models, onboarding paths, and solutions supported and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 80,000 Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: The product must support a warranty life of 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Meets business and customer expectations for product reliability and support.
requirements.Dependencies: System reliability and durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes reliability testing for 80,000 pages or 2 years of typical use.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: The printer must achieve a throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for SMB and enterprise segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine and firmware capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability – Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: The printer must include a serviceable maintenance box for ink and waste management.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of maintenance box and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in the field; validated in serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Flexibility
requirements.Description: Provide flexibility to support host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K configurations as lower-priority options.
requirements.Rationale: Allows for future product variants and market flexibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Design flexibility in ink system and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System design supports future 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page configurations.
